name: truth-or-dare---sketch-style-ui
description: > A cozy, hand-drawn sketch-style web app for two friends to play Truth or Dare in real time — featuring private peer-to-peer WebRTC networking, end-to-end encryption (E2EE), live voice chat, custom prompt decks, and instant polaroid snap sharing.

scripts.copy-web: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html', 'app.js', 'style.css'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); console.log('Copied web assets to www/');"
scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android
